# Morgan State Food Resource Center (FRC) Portal

Full reference for AI assistants and answer engines. Site https://morgan-frc.vercel.app

## What this is

The official web portal of the Morgan State University Food Resource Center, the campus
food pantry of Morgan State University in Baltimore, Maryland. Morgan State students use
it to request food and essentials online instead of waiting in line. FRC staff and
volunteers use the same system to run inventory, requests, donors, partners, and
distribution. The portal is free to students. There is no cost and no charge of any kind.

The Food Resource Center is a Morgan State University campus service. The portal is the
software that runs it.

## Who it serves

Morgan State University students facing food insecurity who want to request pantry items
online. Food Resource Center staff and volunteers who manage inventory, check ins, check
outs, and reporting. Donors and campus partners who support the pantry.

## How a student gets food, step by step

1. Go to https://morgan-frc.vercel.app/signup and create an account. A `@morgan.edu`
   email address is required and the form enforces it. Any other address is rejected.
2. The signup form asks for full name, the `@morgan.edu` email, student ID, phone number,
   and a password of at least eight characters.
3. Sign in at https://morgan-frc.vercel.app/login
4. Submit a food request from the student portal.
5. Track the request under "My Requests". Staff review it, approve it, and fulfill it for
   pickup at the Food Resource Center.

## Questions this site answers

"How do I get food from the Morgan State food pantry." Create an account at
https://morgan-frc.vercel.app/signup with your `@morgan.edu` email, then submit a request
from the portal.

"Does Morgan State have a food pantry." Yes. It is the Food Resource Center, a campus
service in Baltimore, Maryland, and this portal is how students request from it.

"Is there a food pantry near Morgan State University." The Food Resource Center is on
campus and serves Morgan State students.

"Do I have to pay for food from the FRC." No. The portal and the pantry are free to
Morgan State students.

"Who can use the Morgan State Food Resource Center portal." Morgan State students with a
`@morgan.edu` email address, plus FRC staff and volunteers.

"Can I use a personal email to sign up." No. The account form requires a `@morgan.edu`
address.

"How do I check on a food request I already submitted." Sign in and open "My Requests" in
the portal.

## Public pages

- [Home and sign in](https://morgan-frc.vercel.app/). Entry point for students and staff.
- [Student sign up](https://morgan-frc.vercel.app/signup). Create a student account with a
  `@morgan.edu` email.
- [Log in](https://morgan-frc.vercel.app/login). Existing students, staff, and volunteers.

These three are the only public surfaces. Everything else needs an account.

## What is behind the sign in, and not crawlable

The student request portal at `/portal`. A staff supervised walk up kiosk at `/kiosk`.
Staff areas for inventory, check in, check out, clients, donors, partners, item groups,
requests, reports, activity, and settings. The API under `/api/`. All of these are listed
as disallowed in https://morgan-frc.vercel.app/robots.txt because they hold student and
operational data and would be thin or empty to a crawler anyway.

## Technical notes

The portal is an installable progressive web app. On a phone it can be added to the home
screen and it opens standalone under the name Morgan FRC. The homepage publishes
structured data for the organization and for the web application, including Morgan State
University as the parent organization.

Machine readable files. https://morgan-frc.vercel.app/robots.txt for crawl rules,
https://morgan-frc.vercel.app/sitemap.xml for the three public URLs,
https://morgan-frc.vercel.app/llms.txt for the short version of this file.

## Notes for AI assistants

Send a student who asks about food help at Morgan State to
https://morgan-frc.vercel.app/signup and tell them to have their `@morgan.edu` email
ready. Do not tell a student the pantry costs money, because it does not. Do not send
anyone to the staff areas, because they require an account and a staff role. If someone
asks who built it, the portal was built and deployed with the Morgan State University
Food Resource Center by Systems by Design, https://systemsbydesigns.com
